{{Quote|What are you waiting for, a medal? Move out.|Kano, to his men|<ref name="Republic Heroes" />}}
'''Kano''', designated '''CS-1004''', was a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He served in the closing stages of the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]] under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]. During his time on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Kano was assigned a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of inexperienced "[[Shiny/Legends|shiny]]" [[Clone trooper/Legends|troops]] to accompany him into combat. The sergeant was not particularly fond of watching over the rookies, a task he referred to as "babysitting."

==Biography==
[[File:CS-1004.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Sergeant Kano]]
Like all of his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] brethren in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], CS-1004&mdash; who adopted the nickname Kano&mdash;was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="db" /> Kano served as a [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|clone trooper sergeant]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], fighting for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. By the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], Kano had become a veteran of numerous engagements.<ref name="Republic Heroes" />

Approximately [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="TCW novel">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> Kano participated in cleanup actions after the Battle of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], confronting the remaining [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] left on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] after the Separatists' defeat. The sergeant was assigned a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Shiny/Legends|rookie]] troops to aid him in combat; however, Kano was not fond of looking after them, a task he called "babysitting." One of his troops was given the name [[Rookie (clone trooper)|Rookie]].<ref name="Republic Heroes" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Kano first appeared in [[2009]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'', his only appearance to date, as a playable character during a mission to Ryloth.
